per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be portable and run on any operating system that supports Java.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must handle database connections flexibly, whether the database is local or remote.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will require collaboration with a database management system (DBMS). The DBMS may be located on the same machine as the product or on a separate machine residing on the same computer network.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be deployable on standard Java web/app servers such as Tomcat and JBoss.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be compatible with at least eight distinct browsers and render correctly in around eighty percent of those tests.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support flexible SMTP settings and common auth/TLS scenarios for email notifications.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must complete routine interactions, such as checking room availability or saving a quick booking, in about five seconds for ninety percent of tasks and in under eight seconds for ninety-eight percent of tasks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must handle around one thousand concurrent requests currently and scale up to around two thousand concurrent requests by the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must have an availability of ninety-nine point nine nine percent, excluding situations where the whole server hardware fails.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must enforce strict access control, allowing only employees or externally approved users with company IDs to log in.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must comply with accessibility standards, ensuring that it can be used by people with disabilities.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support retry mechanisms and sensible backoff for email notifications, with admin alerts if delivery keeps failing.
The system must be deployable on open-source stacks like Tomcat and JBoss, and should not require exotic platform components.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'
